input.prompt: Photoreal full-body concept render of a small, light, wiry kid-size electric humanoid acrobat fighting robot, about 1.4 meters tall and 43 kilograms, bantam weight, fragile and fast. Proportions: a deliberately short compact torso, long legs, and long slender forearms built for pushing off the floor, compact bare mechanical fists. Livery: gloss cobalt-blue shells with gloss bone-white (warm off-white ivory) secondary panels, dark gunmetal mechanical parts; cobalt is the dominant colour. Head: a forward-swept beak-shaped head, like a raked bird skull pointing forward, cobalt on top with a bone-white beak underside, with two round glowing lenses set on the SIDES of the head, one on each side, in dark bezels; no visor, no face band. Hips: each hip is an open tubular cage of thin bent metal tubes, like a roll cage, with the joint drums visible inside it: one actuator drum at the pelvis, a second drum just below it on the upper thigh with its axis turned 90 degrees, and the thigh twist joint hidden inside the top of the thigh; the drum ends are rounded domes with knurled grip texture, not flat discs. Heavy motor mass sits high near the pelvis, the lower legs are slim. Ankles: compact actuator drums mounted high on the shins drive the ankle through two thin parallel push-rods beside the shin. Small flat articulated feet with a split toe and a black rubber sole. Spine: an exposed segmented spine column of stacked gunmetal vertebra blocks runs up the back from the pelvis to the neck, with a visible waist pitch joint; the torso has no chest emblem and no lights on the chest. Electric quasi-direct-drive actuators everywhere, clean machined aluminium, braided cables, no hydraulics, no pistons. Pose: dramatic front three-quarter view, low springy fighting stance, knees deeply bent, weight on the balls of the feet, one long forearm forward as a guard, ready to leap into a flying knee. Dark charcoal studio background suggesting a dim chain-link cage arena, soft key light, cool rim light, subtle floor reflection, 85mm lens, photoreal, high detail, light scuffs on paint edges. It must not look like a white humanoid with grey disc caps: no gloss white shell, no flat grey disc caps with index lines, no vented drum sides, no horizontal visor or LED eye band, no glowing round chest emblem, no sneaker shoes. No text, no numbers, no letters, no logos, no markings, no decals, no symbols anywhere.
